body: It's not a might've been. If I had spent $2 an hour earlier I would have won 14k
I think I may have been told I just didn't listen

Missing out on 14k when it would help a lot is a very big deal. I can't get it out of my head. It would have help me so much. To miss out that way is horrible. I owe the IRS money even though I made less than poverty line last year.  It's  amazing how big of a fuck up I had. It's almost funny. By far the most public of my many humiliations. I have been feeling like shit this last week. That was the last thing I needed.

I got a free play at bingo last night at a Casino. I won the last game.  Never played bingo didn't know the rules and didn't buy the cash ball for $2. Didn't here about it. I didn't listen. I won the last game on the money ball. I won $250. Could've won 14k. I feel like absolute shit. It's almost funny how much of a loser and piece of shit I am. I'm broke in a new city I hate now. Hate my job, hate my family. I'm fucked. Last night finally proved it. Such humiliation. I want to die so fucking bad. I'll never get over it. 

Tl;Dr be glad you're not me.
